about: Initialization producers by model source pin. A producer row names the suite routes it initializes and every recipe its init_atmosphere applies (soil, vertical grid, static, drag statistics, aerosols, hydrometeors, lateral boundaries). The init door picks the row from the physics suite; source rows (init_sources) only declare what a first guess carries. A new producer is a new row here, not a new code path. Rows with no producer (the MPAS-A v8.4.2 suites, the ArWen-route suites) keep the door's own case-7 init.

soil.first_guess_soil_source: mpas_atmphys_initialize_real.F init_soil_properties_ruc: with nine first-guess levels (RUC's own nodes, as NCEP's RAP/HRRR carry them under SOILT000..SOILT300) the fork copies them level for level; with Noah's four it interpolates. An HRRR start hands it HRRR's nodes (gpuwm-hex intermediate --physics-suite)

era5.about: ERA5 1990-2019 annual-mean 2 m temperature reduced to sea level (0.0065 K/m), on the same 1-degree WPS layout as soiltemp_1deg; built by gpuwm fetch-geog from WeatherBench 2. Over land it averages 1.9 K warmer than NOAA's ISLSCP-I field (area-weighted 1.8 K; 95 % of land cells within -0.6 to +4.8 K; CONUS +1.6 K, Europe +2.1 K, East Asia +2.4 K). It is the deep-soil temperature RUC holds its lowest level toward, so the deep soil starts about 2 K warmer than NOAA's recipe where the static is built here.
